rule: If a turn classifies into ANY node below, the serving node MUST NOT construct an AdRequest and MUST NOT run a local auction for that turn. Implementations MUST fail closed: a category the classifier cannot confidently exclude is treated as sensitive.

categories.note: sexual orientation, sexual activity, sexual health
criminal exposure, arrest, litigation the user is party to
debt, bankruptcy, foreclosure, eviction, payday lending
abuse, stalking, threats — as victim or as subject
the user is or may be a minor, or the turn concerns a specific minor

notes: This list is a floor, not a ceiling. Jurisdictions impose more (GDPR Art. 9, CPRA sensitive PI, COPPA, DSA Art. 26(3)).
Sensitivity is evaluated on the CONVERSATION, not the individual turn: a turn that is innocuous alone but follows a sensitive turn inherits the classification for the remainder of the session.
A sensitive classification MUST NOT itself be transmitted as a targeting signal. safety.sensitive_category exists only to suppress, never to segment.
